plate_01.jpg.description: A diagonal split contrasting a warm terracotta Khanewal rooftop coder with a federal navy USPS sorting emblem.

plate_02.jpg.description: A tactile cardstock counter rolling up to 35 Billion Rupees over towering stacks of U.S. postal parcels.

plate_03.jpg.description: Story Circle Step 1 (You): 33-year-old Faheem Akram seated under a slow ceiling fan in a modest Punjab brick room.

plate_04.jpg.description: A stylized tactical map of southern Punjab highlighting Khanewal and his father's small property deed office.

plate_05.jpg.description: Story Circle Step 2 (Need): A software engineering degree juxtaposed against small-town economic stagnation.

plate_06.jpg.description: A split confrontation between Faheem's magnifying lens and a fractured USPS Intelligent Mail barcode matrix.

plate_07.jpg.description: Story Circle Step 3 (Go): In August 2023, Faheem crosses into cybercrime as LabelsBank.com lights up his dark room.

plate_08.jpg.title: File:Small USPS Truck.jpg
plate_08.jpg.description: A white USPS mail van with blue/red stripes racing right as $2 counterfeit barcode labels stamp onto heavy parcels.

plate_09.jpg.description: Story Circle Step 4 (Search): A financial vector map linking 16 bank accounts across Punjab to launder the proceeds.

plate_10.jpg.title: File:Fountain pen writing (literacy).jpg
plate_10.jpg.description: Bank account registration forms bearing the signatures and thumbprints of Faheem's closest relatives.

plate_11.jpg.description: Pre-drop riser: Silhouettes of his wife, sister, and maternal aunt signing papers in warm courtyard light as tension peaks.

plate_12.jpg.description: At the 19-second beat drop, a 6-layer shockwave explosion fractures the USPS vault as $126 MILLION slams in red.

plate_13.jpg.description: A high-speed conveyor belt printing 5.1 million counterfeit labels for 5,200 buyers across the United States.

plate_14.jpg.description: A heavy cargo transport aircraft banking across a crimson dusk sky while golden revenue vectors stream back to Punjab.

plate_15.jpg.description: Faheem surrounded by 7 overflowing bank ledgers inside a gated compound, peering nervously through window blinds.

plate_16.jpg.description: Story Circle Step 6 (Take): A federal gavel shockwave slams a $100,000 USPIS bounty notice across the screen.

plate_17.jpg.description: A tactical cyber-intelligence radar grid connecting U.S. Postal Inspectors in Florida with Pakistan's NCCIA in Lahore.

plate_18.jpg.description: Steel chains slam across 16 bank vaults on the left while his family's silhouettes are illuminated by red sirens on the right.

plate_19.jpg.description: An NCCIA investigation dossier opening to reveal the family tree of accounts: Brother 5, Wife 2, Sister 1, Aunt 1.

plate_20.jpg.description: Story Circle Step 7 (Return): NCCIA tactical vehicles with flashing red and blue beacons racing through Lahore at night.

plate_21.jpg.description: Tactical breach of the Lahore hideout as the wooden door splinters and glowing LabelsBank servers are unplugged.

plate_22.jpg.description: Close-up silhouette of Faheem Akram with bowed head as blued-steel handcuffs lock around his wrists.

plate_23.jpg.description: In quiet Khanewal, silhouettes of neighbors and an elderly father stand before a glowing television screen in grief.

plate_24.jpg.description: A stark confrontation between Faheem in custody and a U.S. federal prison watchtower awaiting extradition.

plate_25.jpg.description: Story Circle Step 8 (Change): The $2 counterfeit label sits atop the completed 8-step circle, charred and stamped SEIZED.

plate_26.jpg.description: The LabelsBank.com monitor shatters outward under a federal seizure seal as digital barcodes dissolve into ash.

plate_27.jpg.description: A solitary silhouette seated in a dark cell as cold iron bars cast stripes across the floor where laptop light once glowed.

plate_28.jpg.description: Symmetric loop back to the Khanewal rooftop at terracotta dusk with an empty chair and closed laptop.
